message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live data feeds, so I can’t give you the current Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles right now.  

If you’d like up‑to‑date information, you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (EPA) | Visit <https://www.airnow.gov/> and enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code. |
| **World Air Quality Index** | Go to <https://waqi.info/> and search for “Los Angeles.” |
| **Local news sites** | Many local stations publish daily AQI updates on their websites. |
| **Mobile apps** | Apps like “AirVisual,” “Plume Labs: Air Report,” or the EPA’s own “AirNow” app show real‑time AQI. |

These resources pull data from monitoring stations across the city and update frequently (often every 15–30 minutes). If you’re planning outdoor activities, it’s a good idea to check the AQI before heading out.
